snippet.title: TSOS Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
TSOS is a Survival-horror game inspired by Silent hill 1 and made using the HPSX render pipeline for a month long horror game jam by a talented team of 5 passionate individuals.

Game link -  https://kawpum.itch.io/tsos

----------------------- Credits -----------------------

Art, Animation, UI sounds - https://kawpum.itch.io/

Art - https://morgis.itch.io/

Art - https://necogames.itch.io/

Music - https://158.itch.io/

Code - https://wolfstien.itch.io/
